card.line: Tishbe was the town linked to Elijah the Tishbite, the prophet who stood before King Ahab and spoke the word of the LORD in Gilead.

moments.title: Elijah speaks to Ahab
moments.text: Elijah the Tishbite, who was among the settlers of Gilead, tells King Ahab that no dew or rain will fall except at his word. He says this in the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

moments.title: Sent to the Brook of Cherith
moments.text: The LORD tells Elijah to leave and hide by the Brook of Cherith, east of the Jordan. Elijah obeys, drinks from the brook, and ravens bring him bread and meat morning and evening.
